$meta.rule: Single source of truth for every user-facing string, on both clients and in every push notification (resolved server-side). No client may hardcode display text. Every string here must pass CLAUDE.md §2 rule 1: never shame. See tools/copylint.
$meta.placeholders: Interpolation uses {braced} names. The same placeholder set must appear in every locale of a key.
$meta.voice: Plain, warm, short. Second person. No exclamation marks. No streaks-as-pressure. Nothing a person would be embarrassed to have read over their shoulder.

app.name: Pod
app.tagline: Two or three people. One small thing a week.
auth.start.title: Let's get you in
auth.start.body: We'll email you a 6-digit code. No password to remember.
auth.start.legal: By continuing you agree to our terms and privacy notice.
auth.start.error.emailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address yet.
auth.verify.title: Check your email
auth.verify.body: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It's good for {minutes} minutes.
auth.verify.error.codeIncorrect: That code didn't match. Give it another go.
auth.verify.error.codeExpired: That code has expired. We can send a fresh one.
auth.verify.error.tooManyAttempts: Let's start over with a new code.
auth.signedOut.title: You're signed out
auth.signedOut.body: Your pod is still there when you come back.
onboarding.intent.title: What have you been putting off?
onboarding.intent.body: One thing. The one that's been sitting there.
onboarding.goal.label: In your words
onboarding.goal.placeholder: Finally sort out the spare room
onboarding.goal.hint: Only your pod will see this.
onboarding.category.title: What kind of thing is it?
onboarding.intensity.title: How much can you give it in a week?
onboarding.intensity.body: Pick what's realistic on a normal week, not a good one. You can change it later.
onboarding.reliability.title: One last thing
onboarding.reliability.body: How often do you keep commitments you make to yourself? There's no right answer — it only helps us pick who you'd get on with.
onboarding.reliability.rarely: Not as often as I'd like
onboarding.timezone.label: Your timezone
onboarding.timezone.body: So your pod's week lines up with yours.
pool.waiting.title: Looking for your pod
pool.waiting.body: We match every hour, so you're not waiting long. We'll let you know.
push.podFormed.title: You've got a pod
push.weekOpened.title: New week
push.memberPosted.title: {name} is in
push.weekClosing.title: Your pod's week closes tomorrow
push.weekClosing.body: Whatever happens, next week opens on Monday.
push.podCompleted.title: Everyone was in
push.proofExpiring.title: This week's proof goes tonight
push.proofExpiring.body: Have a look before it does.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.permission.title: Can we let you know?
notifications.permission.body: Only when your pod does something. Never to chase you.
pod.newlyFormed.title: You're matched
pod.newlyFormed.body: Same goal, same kind of week. Your first action lands soon.
week.defaultAction: One small thing towards it this week.
week.title: This week
week.action.namePrompt: Nobody's named this week's thing yet. You can.
week.action.lockedNote: Someone's already posted, so this week's thing stays as it is.
week.post.ephemeralNote: It disappears when the week closes. Nobody outside your pod ever sees it.
error.weekClosed.title: That week has closed
error.weekClosed.body: This week's open now, whenever you're ready.
error.alreadyPosted.title: You're already in
error.alreadyPosted.body: You posted this week. One is all it takes.
error.actionLocked.title: This week's thing is set
error.actionLocked.body: Someone's already posted against it, so it stays as it is.
error.proofTooLong.title: A little too long
error.proofTooLong.body: Ten seconds is all we keep. Have another go.
error.proofTooLarge.title: That file's large
error.proofTooLarge.body: Try a shorter clip or a smaller photo.
error.uploadIncomplete.title: That didn't send
error.uploadIncomplete.body: Nothing arrived. Give it another go.
a11y.postProof: Post your ten seconds of proof
error.alreadyInPod.title: You're already in a pod
error.alreadyInPod.body: One pod at a time, and yours is waiting for you.
error.goalTooShort.title: A few more words
error.goalTooShort.body: Tell us a little more so we can match you well.
email.loginCode.subject: Your Pod code: {code}
email.loginCode.body: Here's your sign-in code: {code}. It's good for {minutes} minutes. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this.
state.member.resting.detail: {name} sat this one out. The pod carries on.
state.member.you.resting.detail: You sat this one out. Next week is open.
state.pod.restartingNote: The pod picks back up this week.
error.network.title: Can't reach Pod
error.network.body: Check your connection and try again.
error.server.title: Something's off on our end
error.server.body: Nothing you did. Try again in a moment.
error.rateLimited.title: Hang on a moment
error.rateLimited.body: Too many tries just now. Try again in {seconds}s.
error.sessionExpired.title: Time to sign in again
error.sessionExpired.body: For your security we sign you out after a while.
